# Project instructions

Follow AGENTS.md and Docs/Research. Preserve RTXPT1.9 source/assets baseline, immutable B1 and B2/B3 version identities, component licenses and independent quality/performance evidence. B1 is a DI/GI runtime/API migration; the separate linked SDK is reference-only, and no new ReSTIR PT path is implied.

B2 ReSTIR PT integration is in progress with scoped static opaque HDR validation and cap-verified native-control timings; it is not promoted. See Docs/Research/B2_RESULTS.md for the current measured checkpoint. B3 has a scoped measured footprint/initial-only-roulette pilot (Docs/Research/B3_RESULTS.md), not a complete PT++ port. B4 owns all remaining PT++ work (Docs/Research/B4_IMPLEMENTATION.md). Read Docs/Research/B2_IMPLEMENTATION.md and Benchmarks/versions.json; preserve immutable B0/B1 and reject overlapping GI/PT lighting without a valid partition/MIS. Future benchmarks require explicit uncapped renderer controls plus recorded driver/external-cap coverage.

New variant results must include actual algorithm labels and visible original Convergence (convergence-test.scene.json), Kitchen (kitchen-with-test-stuff.scene.json) and owned opaque-room rows. Show missing/unsupported cases and convergence coverage explicitly; preserve original materials/camera and separate historical unverified-cap results from cap-verified throughput. See Docs/Research/ALGORITHM_VARIANTS.md. B3 is preserved on b3/ptpp-activation; its isolated footprint/initial-only-roulette pilot is not a complete PT++ port. Continue remaining work as B4 after preserving B3.
